BLOCKING_DEFECT.diagnosis: The cup artwork was rendered into a 1375x1479 box (aspect 0.930) and then padded to the required 1375x1578 (aspect 0.871) with a black bar, instead of being rendered at the true placeholder aspect. It is an export artifact, not design content - visually confirmed as a hard-edged bar sitting below a cleanly finished cup silhouette on white.
BLOCKING_DEFECT.production_impact: Dye sublimation prints the print area as supplied. The bottom 6.27% of each ear cup would carry solid black, either as a band or as a blackened lower edge, on every unit sold.
BLOCKING_DEFECT.why_not_fixed_here: Creative is locked - no redesign, regeneration, recolour or substitution permitted - and cropping or rescaling the master would also break the package's mandated 1:1 exact-fit mapping. Per the ownership boundary, production geometry that exposes a creative problem returns to ChatGPT Creative.
BLOCKING_DEFECT.required_fix: Re-export both masters with the cup silhouette rendered to the full 1375x1578 print area at aspect 0.8714, with no letterbox padding. Artwork content, palette, motifs and composition stay exactly as approved - this is a re-export at the correct aspect, not a redesign.
